data.content:
**Summary**

I sent one dispute: **UE-tf06f ($31.20)**. The owner approved it.
- Win probability is 90%, the strongest case in the file.
- The order ticket lists only Paneer Tikka Masala and Garlic Naan. The claimed Butter Chicken isn't on it.
- The order was ready at 18:47 and picked up at 18:50.

**Drafted but skipped by the owner.** I did not retry any of these.
- **UE-tf07g ($26.80, 75%):** The ticket lists Chicken Tikka. The order was ready at 13:32 and picked up at 13:38.
- **UE-tf02b ($21.50, 75%):** The ticket lists Lamb Biryani. The order was ready at 19:22 and picked up at 19:26.
- **UE-tf03c ($15.00, 87%):** The ticket lists Garlic Naan. The order was ready at 20:33 and picked up at 20:36.
- In all three, the ticket shows the item was ordered, but nothing shows what was in the bag after pickup, so I rated them moderate.
- I left the repeat-claimant count on UE-tf03c (3 claims from one account) out of the dispute, so it can't read as a comment on the customer.

**Weak: UE-tf01a ($52.00, 30%).** No order ticket is on file, so I can't compare the claimed Chicken Biryani (Family Size) to what was prepared. It started as the top case and dropped in the queue. **I need a photo of the ticket for order UE-tf01a from you.** Once I have it, I'll re-run the evidence. It's the largest deduction.

**Not investigated.**
- UE-tf04d ($18.25, 45%) and UE-tf05e ($12.75, 55%) were outside the top 5, so I haven't checked them.
- UE-tf08h ($9.00), UE-tf09i ($14.00, 15%) and UE-tf00z ($0.00, deadline passed 5 days ago) are recommended skips.

**Lessons from memory.** None applied. My stored lessons are all DoorDash, and recall found no resolved Uber Eats missing-item cases, so I haven't cited any.

**Next deadline:** 2026-12-12 (28 days). Case notes are in `/plan.md`. When Uber Eats rules on UE-tf06f, tell me and I'll record the outcome.
